mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.food_id, f.name AS food_name, c.order_id, u.username, u.nickname, c.rating, c.content, c.created_at FROM comment c JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id JOIN food f ON f.id = c.food_id WHERE c.food_id = #{foodId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND food_id = #{foodId}
